settings.heading: One quiet minute, head to toe.
settings.content: No 7-step routine. Just warm, massage, and let it absorb.

settings.title: Warm the drops
settings.text: Press 4–6 drops between your palms until they warm.

settings.title: Massage upward
settings.text: Sweep over clean skin in upward strokes — thighs, tummy, arms.

settings.title: Let it absorb
settings.text: It sinks in fast — dress straight away. Use daily for best results.

settings.heading: Get the most from your bottle

settings.a: Applying just after a shower helps lock that moisture in — and the oil glides further.
4–6 drops is plenty. It's the daily one-minute habit, not the amount, that changes how skin looks.
